summary: The PR addresses the issue of incorrect serialization of nested class methods in migrations but introduces some unnecessary files and has a minor style issue.

issues.description: The PR includes unnecessary files like `db.sqlite3`, `testapp/__init__.py`, and `testapp/migrations/__init__.py` which are not related to the fix.
The `default` method in `Capability` returns a string instead of a list as per the original issue description. This might be intentional but could be a minor inconsistency.
